functions.name: delUser
functions.notes: Requires caller Auth access_token plus reauthenticate verify_code. No uid accepted.

functions.name: cleanupDeletedUsers
functions.notes: Internal retry worker only; do not configure an HTTP route.

requiredCollections.name: account_deletion_jobs
requiredCollections.purpose: Durable deletion saga state; delUser must be able to insert and cleanupDeletedUsers must be able to query/update it.
